headline: Bank of Japan Accelerates ETF Sales to Fund Policy Initiatives
summary: The Bank of Japan is speeding up its exchange-traded fund sales, a move that could potentially boost funding for government plans.
why: The Bank of Japan manages monetary policy and asset holdings, influencing domestic liquidity and equity markets.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: BOJ asset sales alter central bank holdings and funding structures in Japan.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Accelerated ETF sales by the central bank alter market dynamics for domestic equities and government funding mechanisms.
